figurative_meaning_en: Swearing an oath in the name of God
example_sentences_in_bangla: খোদার কসম, আমি কখনো মিথ্যা বলিনি।
তুমি বিশ্বাস কর না? খোদার কসম, সব সত্যি।
example_sentences_in_english: By God, I have never lied.
Don't you believe me? I swear to God, it's all true.
history: Derived from Persian 'Khoda' meaning God, commonly used in Islamic-influenced Bengali expressions for solemn oaths.
note: Primarily used in Muslim Bengali communities for emphatic truth-telling.
